summary: Stellarnet VPC: silent streaming stalls during KMS rotation -> fanout retry snowball + invoice exposure
description:
Issue summary:
During a scheduled KMS key rotation on the private control plane for Stellarnet (private deployment), a subset of long-lived websocket streams entered a silent stall state where the connection remained open but no token frames were emitted for 3-20s intervals. Impacted sessions saw partial transcript loss and in several request patterns triggered service-side replays that produced duplicate completions, creating an unexpected billing delta for the customer.

Impact:
- Customer-facing: real-time chat features experienced intermittent silence and truncated replies for ~45 minutes during the morning peak (us-east).
- Billing exposure: duplicate completions and replayed suffixes led to an estimated 18% token billing increase for affected requests in the window.
- SLA: multiple tenant-level p99 latency and streaming error SLOs were breached.

Timeline (key events):
- 2026-03-10T09:10 UTC: Scheduled KMS rotation started for Stellarnet private control plane (announced via maintenance window).
- 2026-03-10T09:12 UTC: First customer report via support channel: "streaming silent; no tokens despite ws open". Ticket created.
- 2026-03-10T09:14 UTC: SRE observed increased per-connection retry activity and burst in request fanout metrics on serving-runtime.
- 2026-03-10T09:20 UTC: Autoscaler triggered node eviction in one private cluster due to perceived unhealthy pods (control-plane LB health-check flaps).
- 2026-03-10T09:25-09:55 UTC: Silent stalls observed intermittently; duplicates and short replay windows recorded.
- 2026-03-10T10:05 UTC: Temporary mitigation deployed: disabled aggressive retry policy on private control plane and incremented keepalive.
- 2026-03-10T11:00 UTC: Full resolution: KMS rotation completed; control plane health normalized and aggressive retry policy reverted with stricter idempotency checks.

Steps to reproduce (internal):
1) On a private tenant with websocket streaming and short-lived requests, initiate a KMS key rotation while simultaneously rolling the control plane.
2) Observe streaming connections that fail handshake for a subset of frames (rekeying handshakes succeed at TLS layer but application-layer session tokens are temporarily unavailable).
3) The serving runtime's multipath fanout retries re-queue inflight suffixes causing replayed tokens.

Logs / dashboards referenced:
- Serving runtime fanout-retries graph: dashboard ID dash/serving/fanout-retries (spike aligned with 09:14-09:55).
- Control plane healthcheck logs: controlplane-rotation-2026-03-10.log (S3 link in investigation notes).
- Billing delta estimate spreadsheet: https://sheets.redwood.ai/stellarnet-billing-delta-MAR10 (access granted to CS+Finance).

Immediate mitigations performed:
- Disabled aggressive application-level retry policy (reduced fanout multiplier) at 09:30 UTC.
- Increased websocket keepalive and extended token TTL for in-flight sessions at 09:35 UTC.
- Issued temporary per-tenant rate cap to avoid amplification at 09:40 UTC.

Current status: Resolved. Root cause analysis and long-term mitigation in progress; customer received mitigation update and a provisional billing credit (see resolution).
investigation_notes: Hypothesis 1: KMS rotation caused a small window where application JWT signing (control plane) returned temporary 503/unavailable leading to application-layer token gaps despite TLS being up.
Hypothesis 2: Autoscaler eviction triggered pod churn while control plane rotated, producing out-of-order handshakes and a replay window in the serving runtime's multipath fanout logic.
Evidence: controlplane-rotation-2026-03-10.log shows 09:11-09:18 rotation handshake latencies; serving runtime traces show increased fanout_retries with 'suffix_replay' tag between 09:14-09:50.
Mitigating PRs: controlplane PR #9821 adds rotation drain marker; serving-runtime PR #1773 introduces idempotency token for streaming frames to prevent replay duplication.
Cross-ref: discussed on #support-private in Slack thread https://slack.redwood.ai/archives/C01234XYZ/p16784712 (redacted).

resolution: Mitigation: disabled aggressive retries and extended token TTL during incident; deployed idempotency and rotation-drain changes post-incident. Billing: provisional 10% credit issued for impacted window; Finance to reconcile final credit after exact token delta confirmed. Permanent fix: control-plane to mark rotation drains and serving-runtime to enforce per-frame idempotency so replays are dropped. Rollout: PRs merged to main and scheduled canary in private clusters week of 2026-03-21.
